surfaces.name: Classic taskbar widget
surfaces.width: 42 + providers.count * (ceil(10 / max(1, providers.count)) * 11 - 1 + 4 + 62) + max(0, providers.count - 1) * 3 + (providers.opencode.enabled + providers.cursor.enabled) * 28 + providers.claude.enabled * claude.model.fable.available * if((providers.claude.enabled && claude.weekly.available && !claude.session.available && claude.model.fable.available), 28 + 28 * (providers.count > 1), 93)

children.name: Claude Code usage
children.x: if((providers.claude.enabled && claude.weekly.available && !claude.session.available && claude.model.fable.available), canvas.width - 1 - ((ceil(10 / max(1, providers.count)) * 11 - 1) + 4 + 90 + 28), 41 + providers.cursor.enabled * ((ceil(10 / max(1, providers.count)) * 11 - 1) + 4 + 90 + 3))
children.width: if((providers.claude.enabled && claude.weekly.available && !claude.session.available && claude.model.fable.available), (ceil(10 / max(1, providers.count)) * 11 - 1) + 4 + 90 + 28, (ceil(10 / max(1, providers.count)) * 11 - 1) + 4 + 62)

children.name: Fable weekly meter
children.x: canvas.width - 1 - if((providers.claude.enabled && claude.weekly.available && !claude.session.available && claude.model.fable.available), (ceil(10 / max(1, providers.count)) * 11 - 1) + 4 + 90, 90)

content.segments_expression: if((providers.claude.enabled && claude.weekly.available && !claude.session.available && claude.model.fable.available), ceil(10 / max(1, providers.count)), 8)
